statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the chosen name is rejected by the Cámara de Comercio, the applicant may submit a written reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) to the same registry within 10 business days, and if denied, an appeal (recurso de apelación) to the competent Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for administrative review.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for low-risk webnovel and subscription mobile platform businesses, provided a local registered address in Colombia is maintained and a registered agent with physical presence is appointed; a purely virtual address without any substance may trigger tax residency rebuttal and lost beneficial treaty access.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), articles 1-10 and 17-20; Código de Comercio (Decree 410/1971), articles 98-115 (registration); Decree 1074/2015 (anti-red tape provisions).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Chamber of Commerce of Bogotá) and Superintendencia de Sociedades (oversight).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Instrument), optionally elevated to Escritura Pública if real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None legally required for S.A.S.; capital may be zero or nominal, subscribed freely, with each share paid at least 25% up front and full payment within 2 years. No escrow or banked capital requirement for digital service platforms.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE INITIAL BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY] S.A.S. — The undersigned founding shareholders, having subscribed to the Company's capital and adopted the by-laws, resolve unanimously: (1) to ratify the share subscription and payment schedule as per Exhibit A; (2) to adopt the registered office at [Address], Bogotá D.C., and authorize the legal representative to formalize leases and public registrations; (3) to appoint [Name] as Legal Representative, [Name] as Company Secretary, and [Name] as Compliance Officer, with full powers under the by-laws; (4) to instruct the legal representative to complete all filings before the Cámara de Comercio, DIAN, and municipal authorities; and (5) to approve the initial bank account opening with a domestic regulated bank. Unanimously passed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Final RUT, Bank Account, and Digital Signature Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) and a supervised bank (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Visit the designated DIAN window or use the RUES-enabled online process to complete the definitive RUT registration, including economic activity classification (ISIC 9000 / NAICS 511130). Open a corporate checking account for the S.A.S. with the bank of choice, presenting the commercial registration certificate, NIT, and by-laws. Then activate a digital certificate (Certificado Digital) with the DIAN-approved certifier (e.g., GSE, Certicámara) for e-invoicing and electronic filing.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
e-invoicing software contract or SaaS subscription confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT confirmation is delayed, monitor RUES and DIAN online status; if the NIT is not active, file a priority petition with DIAN and submit proof of commercial registration. For bank rejection (e.g., unresolved KYC), supply updated due diligence documents—certified final beneficial owners and source of funds declaration—and reapply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for digital web fiction platform; if an office or data center is established, jurisdiction falls under the local Alcaldía (Mayor's office) for commercial occupancy permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No specific operating license for online content platforms in Colombia; general digital service tax registration applies. Any optional certification is the 'Certificado de Funcionamiento' issued by the local municipality for commercial premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for regional office impacts
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 3 under Decree 1076/2015 (digital and IT services have no mandatory EIA).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for emissions or wastewater. E-waste from IT equipment must be disposed under Resolution 1466/2019 through licensed recyclers. No VOC discharges; office sewage is municipal utility (Acueducto y Alcantarillado) permissible.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The company's physical office (if any) must obtain a 'Certificado de Bomberos' (fire safety certificate) from the local Fire Department, pass the structural load inspection for leased premises (issued by a licensed architect or engineer), and register an occupational health and safety program with the Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) under Resolution 2388/2021.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a managed floating exchange-rate regime and a dual-calendar system under Decree 1068 of 2015 and the external resolutions of Banco de la República. Current-account transactions, including profit remittances, service payments, and royalties, are freely convertible but must be channelled through the authorized exchange market (mercado cambiario) using a local commercial bank or licensed FX intermediary. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, are generally permitted without prior exchange authorization but require registration in Banco de la República's electronic system and, for certain cross-border loans, a local market obligation. Profit remittances by an S.A.S. to non-resident shareholders are allowed once annual or occasional dividends are approved; the local paying bank verifies the corporate minutes, current dividend withholding tax certificates, and the absence of unpaid capital obligations before converting COP into foreign currency at the market rate (TRM).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export receivables from Colombian services, including digital content platforms, must be repatriated into the local exchange market within six (6) months from the invoice date or the contractual maturity, whichever is applicable. Banco de la República requires that proceeds received by the S.A.S. from foreign customers be transferred to an authorized local bank and, unless an approved foreign-currency account is used for operational cash management, at least 100% of the invoice value must be surrendered in exchange for Colombian pesos. The exporter must present to the bank the commercial invoice, the signed service agreement, and the foreign-exchange conversion form (Formulario No. 4 or its electronic equivalent) when the funds convert from USD/COP at the prevailing daily TRM rate.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility. Colombian law does not grant non-bank electronic-money institutions the legal capacity to open local COP-denominated settlement accounts that can receive export proceeds or disburse funds in compliance with the foreign-exchange market regime. Offshore digital EMIs, including global neobanks and FX fintech platforms, may be used only as auxiliary payment channels prior to corporate bank sign-off; they must never act as the principal collection account for the WeBNovel platform because funds held with such EMIs are outside the local exchange market, cannot be processed under a Banco de la República foreign-exchange declaration, and may trigger DIAN tax-basis mismatches and AML reclassification. Their use is acceptable for small operational expenses and acquirer settlements where the underlying transaction is routed to a licensed local bank within 24–72 hours.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In the initial account-opening phase, Colombian regulated financial institutions generally require a physical or videoconferenced KYC interview with the legal representative of the S.A.S. and the principal beneficial owner. For a foreign-owned Colombian S.A.S., the account-opening protocols of tier-1 banks commonly require: (i) the legal representative from the S.A.S. to appear at a branch in Bogotá, Medellín, or Barranquilla, or (ii) a videoconference KYC session with a Colombian notary in attendance and the original corporate documents legalized by apostille and certified by an official translator. If the board appoints a local compliance officer or a local attorney-in-fact with a notarized power of attorney, that person must complete a satisfactory face-to-face interview with the bank's compliance officer. Remote opening without any physical presence is rarely approved; the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia expects banks to verify the residential and business address, source of funds, and the identity of all natural-person shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity due to non-resident shareholders holding dormant S.A.S. quotas.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed UBO declaration (declaración de beneficiario final); notarized and apostilled quota-holding certificate; chain-of-ownership chart from ultimate natural persons; signed compliance attestation by the S.A.S. legal representative; audited sub-consolidated financial statements if a holding company is in the chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from a high-risk jurisdiction or a jurisdiction on FATF/Colombian authorities' watchlist.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements of the transferring account for the prior six months; proper wire purpose code 'Foreign Direct Investment – Capital Increase'; payment-side KYC onboarding pack showing the counterparty's corporate registry excerpt; statutory declaration of compliance with Colombian tax and exchange regulations; evidence that the funds originated from an operating-revenue run by the investor rather than from an unregulated crypto or gambling source.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP status or politically exposed family connection of a shareholder or director.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed PEP questionnaire for each natural person; transparent description of the shareholding relationship; independent heritage search report issued by an accredited sanctions/PEP database; a written opinion from a Colombian attorney explaining the legitimacy of the remittance; bank request for an enhanced due-diligence file including the constitutional contract, operating agreements, and confirmation of no Colombian public-procurement ties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency between the registered legal representative and the actual controller making the day-to-day treasury decisions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authenticated board minutes appointing the day-to-day manager; notarized special power of attorney in favor of the local payments officer; corporate by-laws showing the authority matrix; a compliance undertaking executed by the actual controller agreeing to be bound by bank AML policies; sworn statement of administrative domicile in Colombia.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative media/sanctions flags on the parent group or its upstream software-services supplier.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-screening results from Thomson Reuters or similar; corporate due-diligence report issued by a licensed Colombian investigator; open-source adverse-media review with dated and sourced references; explanation of the actual IP licensing chain; annual internal AML compliance certificate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign investors subscribing new S.A.S. quota payments must remit the capital via SWIFT MT103 from their foreign bank to the S.A.S.'s operational or escrow account at a Colombian tier-1 bank. The wire must include the NBC/Chips code of the receiving bank, an unambiguous reference to the S.A.S. tax ID (NIT), and the beneficiary account number. The local bank screens the incoming wire and applies the correct FX conversion at the TRM rate. For regulatory compliance, the S.A.S. must report the transaction as a direct foreign investment through Banco de la República's electronic system (registered before or immediately after the capital injection) using the designated purpose code for equity investment in local companies. Supporting evidence of a successful registration is a prerequisite for later dividend remittances and capital repatriation. Funds received without the registered investment code will be held under 'suspense' and may be classified as external debt rather than equity unless the company submits the updated company registry certificate showing the capital increase.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The platform's treasury will disburse local content payments, translator fees, and employee wages inside Colombia through the ACH (Cámara de Compensación) and CENIT clearing rails, denominated exclusively in COP. Cross-border copyright royalty payments and service fees to authors, agent of record, or platform operators will be paid by SWIFT MT103 using standard income codes such as 'services rendered to non-residents', 'royalties/licence payments', and 'external trade services'. For contractual settlements under commercial letters of credit, the issuing Colombian bank will transmit an MT700 documentary credit to the beneficiary's bank, final settlement being made by MT103 against a compliant presentation of the digital copyright assignment document, platform usage dashboard, and tax invoice. Any outbound foreign-remittance to non-resident subsidiaries or related parties must include a transfer-pricing statement confirmed by DIAN form 110 (annual informative return) and, where applicable, an advance transfer-pricing agreement. The S.A.S. must retain the FX purchase/sale transaction reports, the receipts of the DIAN withholding tax certificates (e.g., certificates of remittance for services), and a centralized e-file of MT103/SWIFT confirmations for a minimum of ten years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Merchant Registry Annual Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce corresponding to registered domicile)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest surcharge (approximately 1.5% per month plus monetary sanctions), loss of the right to file commercial documents, and prolonged non-renewal leads to administrative cancellation of the merchant registration by the Chamber of Commerce.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficiary/UBO Confirmation (Declaración de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) via Registro Único Tributario (RUT) and cross-confirmed through the Chamber of Commerce renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the DIAN-designated RUT update period, normally between July and September based on NIT ending digit; exact dates published by DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under tax regulations (Ley 2010 de 2019), potential suspension of the RUT, and adverse effects on tax clearance certificates; heedlessness may trigger penalty up to 100 UVTs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Approval and Registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce (registration and public filing) after approval by the Shareholders' Assembly
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements to be reviewed and approved by the Assembly within 3 months after fiscal year-end (March 31); registration with the Chamber of Commerce occurs together with the merchant registry renewal window ending March 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inability to legally report accurate economic information, technical sanctions on the administrator/representative, fines under commercial inspection, and potential impediment to the annual renewal itself.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed annually according to the national filing calendar, typically between March and April in the year following the taxable year, based on NIT last two digits
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of tax due plus interest (2% per month), and failure to file for extended periods may lead to administrative default assessment, assets seizures, and criminal referral for willful non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory revisor fiscal (independent statutory auditor) is mandatory when, at the prior fiscal year-end, the entity's gross assets exceed 5,000 monthly legal minimum wages (SMLMV) or its annual gross revenues exceed 3,000 SMLMV; smaller SAS may contract an independent accountant for voluntary review unless the bylaws or shareholders require an auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian GAAP under Law 1314/2009 and Decree 2420/2015 as amended; the entity applies Grupo 2 (NIIF para Pymes) unless classified under Grupo 3 (NIF para microempresas) based on employee and revenue thresholds, with IFRS (Grupo 1) reserved for publicly traded or significant public-interest entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The beneficial ownership (UBO) register is subject to annual confirmation and update at the same time as the March 31 merchant registry renewal; in addition, all share transfers during the previous fiscal year must be entered in the share register and the UBO information must be reported to DIAN within the annual RUT update period. Any change in ultimate ownership outside the annual window triggers an immediate register update and DIAN notice.

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (general CIT rate under Article 240 E.T. for fiscal years 2023 and later; no municipal or departmental corporate income tax overlay, though ICA (industry & commerce) tax applies at municipal level on gross revenue from digital platform activity at rates ~0.2%–1.14%).
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for ISIC 9000 digital publishing. Preferential rules: (i) SIMPLE integration regime — small entities with gross revenue ≤ 100,000 UVT (COP 4.98 billion in 2025) may elect a combined income tax/ICA/self-retention rate on gross revenue of approx. 1.8%–14.5% depending on activity; (ii) 25% tax credit for investment in research, technological development and innovation under Article 256-1 E.T.
